defects_argued.note: notice and order issued against a dead person
defects_argued.quote: In view of provisions of Section 93 of the GST Act and bearing in mind the afore-noted decisions, the action of the Assistant Commissioner of GST and Central Excise, Cuttack-I Division, Cuttack cannot be defended and the notice and the order against a dead person cannot be sustained as they are rendered non est in the eye of law.

outcome.quote: With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition is disposed of and pending Interlocutory Application(s), if any, shall be deemed to have been disposed of.
